device.manufacturer: Dahua Technology (Amcrest is a US brand on Dahua firmware)
device.name: Amcrest / Dahua IP Camera / NVR
device.notes:
Amcrest is a US brand OEM'd on Dahua firmware; the two share a CGI/HTTP API and RTSP. They are ONVIF Profile S devices and fully controllable locally with no cloud (relevant given Dahua's NDAA restrictions in the US). Amcrest/Dahua publish an official CGI/HTTP SDK.
PORTS: HTTP 80 (configurable), HTTPS 443, RTSP 554. AUTH: HTTP Digest (falls back to Basic).
CGI (base http://{ip}/cgi-bin/...):
  /cgi-bin/magicBox.cgi?action=getSystemInfo | getDeviceType | getMachineName
    | getVendor | getSoftwareVersion   — identity/system
  /cgi-bin/configManager.cgi?action=getConfig&name=... / setConfig&...
  /cgi-bin/snapshot.cgi?channel={n}     — still image
  /cgi-bin/global.cgi                    — login endpoint
  /cgi-bin/ptz.cgi?action=getStatus      — PTZ
  /cgi-bin/coaxialControlIO.cgi?action=getStatus&channel=1  — light/siren
  /cgi-bin/eventManager.cgi?action=attach&codes=[...]&heartbeat=5 — event stream

RTSP live: rtsp://user:pass@{ip}:554/cam/realmonitor?channel=1&subtype=0 (subtype 0 = main, 1 = sub; channel selects the camera).
Discovery: ONVIF WS-Discovery (see onvif.yaml) plus direct CGI/RTSP on the known ports; identity via magicBox.cgi getSystemInfo/getMachineName/getVendor.

openness.notes: The CGI + RTSP surface is officially documented (Amcrest CGI SDK / Dahua HTTP API). A newer DHIP binary RPC2 protocol exists and is separately reverse-engineered (see helpful_urls). See onvif.yaml for ONVIF discovery.

credentials.notes: Local control uses the camera's admin credential over HTTP Digest. Onboarding is app/UI-mediated and not documented here.

factory_reset.effect: Clears network config and admin password. Performed by holding the reset button; the hold time is model-specific.

procedures.basis: Dahua/Amcrest document a reset-button hold per model; not replayed here.
procedures.name: Reset button hold

steps.action: Hold the camera's reset button until it reboots into setup.
steps.expect: The camera returns to first-boot state.

methods.description: Onboard the camera, set the admin password on first boot, then use the local CGI API over HTTP Digest and pull RTSP from port 554.

steps.action: Onboard the camera onto the LAN and set the admin password on first boot.
Log in over /cgi-bin/global.cgi (Digest) and read RTSP from cam/realmonitor.

setup.notes: The camera joins the LAN; Dahua firmware forces an admin password on first boot. Local HTTP Digest login thereafter, no cloud. Provisioning wire steps are not documented here.

rejoin.notes: Network settings are changed from the camera UI while reachable.

testing.notes: Not driven against hardware by this project. The CGI paths, RTSP URI, ports and digest auth are from Amcrest's official CGI SDK PDF and the rroller/dahua Home Assistant client.
